items.html: And once I heard from my master, may his memory be blessed, that the aforementioned nine Sefirot were divided into three parts: for their GAR, which are KHB, spread in AA; and HGT in ZA; and NHY in the Nukva. And in this you will understand why the existence of AVI was not mentioned in the Idra Rabba except at the end, in the Idra Zuta, for AVI hang on the Mazal.
